output.one_liner: Cloud data warehouse platform for querying, loading, and managing data with REST APIs and SQL.

auth.notes: Composio-managed OAuth not available; users must create custom OAuth security integration in their Snowflake account with ACCOUNTADMIN role; per-user setup required.

evidence.snippet: Snowflake has no Composio-managed OAuth app, so you create an OAuth security integration in your own Snowflake account
You need the `ACCOUNTADMIN` role, or a role with the privilege to create integrations.
Authorization: Bearer oauth_token where oauth_token is the generated OAuth token.

access.notes: 30-day free trial accounts available with complimentary credits; continued use beyond trial requires paid plan.

evidence.snippet: If you are using a 30-day trial account , which provides free credits, you won't incur any costs.
The Snowflake SQL API is a REST API that you can use to access and update data in a Snowflake database.
Submit SQL statements for execution. Check the status of the execution of a statement. Cancel the execution of a statement.

buildability.rationale: SQL API is well-documented and Composio toolkit exists (17 tools), but setup requires ACCOUNTADMIN role and per-user OAuth integration creation in each user's account.

overview_evidence.snippet: You can use this API to develop custom applications and integrations that perform queries and manage deployment.
